successors.name: Ancient Pueblo Peoples
successors.text: infobox "Followed by: Ancient Pueblo People"; the page gives no land or year for the hand-over

ledger.x: 5440 BCE: the Oshara tradition begins in New Mexico and Colorado.
4800 BCE: the Bajada phase of the Oshara.
800 BCE: the En Medio phase of the Oshara.
460 CE: the Oshara tradition gives way to the Ancient Pueblo People.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; New Mexico and Colorado are the infobox range, not a frontier.
